skills.name: Behind the Kindness
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Natasha's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
skills.desc: Restores a single ally for #1[f1]% of Natasha's Max HP plus #4[i]. Restores the ally for another #2[f1]% of Natasha's Max HP plus #5[i] at the beginning of each turn for #3[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Gift of Rebirth
skills.desc: Heals all allies for #1[f1]% of Natasha's Max HP plus #2[i].

skills.name: Innervation
skills.desc: When healing allies with HP percentage at #1[i]% or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by #2[i]%. This effect also works on continuous healing.

skills.name: Hypnosis Research
skills.desc:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to #4[i]% of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a #1[i]% base chance to Weaken all enemies.
While Weakened, enemies deal #2[i]% less DMG to allies for #3[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Soothe
passives.desc: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from one designated ally.

passives.name: Recuperation
passives.desc: Increases the duration of Skill's continuous healing effect for 1 turn(s).
